# P36.62 — Task and campaign pages, redirects and dossier gap links (K11 RQ-03b)

Manifest row 405. Branch `r11/P36.62-task-and-campaign-pages`, stacked on `r11/P36.61-queue-hub-facets-cards` (the operator retargets to `main`). `live_verification=false` — no `live:`-leg, no production mutation, no gate flips, no claim-spine write.

## What landed

| route | content |
|---|---|
| `/task/<handle>/` | the task detail page — the K11 §5.3 blocks (status line, what's unknown, why it matters, subject and place, what SIG already has, triggered by, suggested sources, records-request draft [named absence until RQ-04], closing condition, how to act, possible outcomes, history, related, technical details), each a value or a named absence (SIG-RQ-002) |
| `/task/<handle>.json` | the `sig.task-page/1` JSON twin — the same fields the page renders |
| `/task/<task_id>/` | the id-alias stub — 0-second meta refresh + link to the current handle (SIG-RQ-009); `redirects.conf` gains the 301 in every mode via `taskHandleRows` (artifact rows + per-card derivation, emitted-target-gated) |
| `/research-queue/campaign/<handle>/` | the campaign page (K11 §5.4) — field, subject class, place, count, why, OSM contribution path with the honest MapRoulette absence until HG-08, member list, shard download note |

Links-in (SIG-RQ-008): every 'What we don't know' gap and every typed-absence row resolves to the real task or campaign page — or names the absence, never a guessed link. Queue cards and campaign rows now link their titles to the detail pages.
